health.offline: Can't reach the app. Please close it and open it again.

home.hello: Hi! What would you like to do today? 👋
home.sub: Make TikTok selling videos, one easy step at a time.
home.emptyText: Just tell us the product. We'll write 5 scripts, show you what to film, and edit the videos for you.
home.quickSchedSub: Post to TikTok at the best times
new.title: Add a new product
new.sub: Tell us what you're selling. We'll research it and write 5 video scripts for you.
new.whatPh: e.g. Solomon mattress 6ft, or paste a TikTok Shop / Shopee / Lazada link
new.whatHint: Type the product name, or paste a link.
new.dropSub: or drag them here / press ⌘V to paste
new.notesPh: e.g. presenter is a woman in her 30s, free shipping, has FDA number
new.goHint: Takes about 2–6 minutes. You can do other things while you wait.
prov.manual.short: you — free copy & paste into ChatGPT
prov.claude_code.title: 🔑 Your Claude account (recommended)
prov.claude_code.desc: Uses the Claude plan you already pay for (Pro/Max). No extra cost.
prov.manual.title: 🆓 Free — copy & paste yourself
prov.manual.desc: Nothing to sign up for. We prepare the text, you paste it into ChatGPT or Claude and copy the answer back.
prov.claude.title: ⚡ Claude, fully automatic (pay per use)
prov.claude.desc: Enter a key once and it does everything. About ฿1–30 per product.
prov.openai.title: ⚡ ChatGPT, fully automatic (pay per use)
prov.openai.desc: Enter an OpenAI key once and it does everything.
next.label: Next step:
next.writing: ⏳ We're researching and writing your scripts (2–6 minutes). Nothing to do — just wait.
next.rendering: ⏳ We're making your videos. We'll let you know when they're ready.
next.paste: Copy the text into ChatGPT or Claude, then paste the answer back below.
next.noPlan: No scripts yet. Tap try again.
next.film: Read the scripts, then film the shots on the list (no need to rename files).
next.voice: Record your voice for video {ids} and send it in.
next.missing: {n} shots still need a clip. Send more, or make the videos anyway — Claude fills those moments with your other clips.

confirm.deleteProductText: Its scripts, clips and finished videos will all be deleted. This can't be undone.
confirm.deleteFileText: If it was a mistake, you can send the file again.
confirm.replanText: Your current scripts (and any edits) will be replaced. Takes 2–6 minutes.
confirm.postNowText: It goes to TikTok immediately instead of at the planned time.
confirm.cancelPostText: It won't be posted. The video file stays, and you can schedule it again later.
job.planWait: Researching the product and trends, then writing 5 scripts — usually 2–6 minutes.
job.renderWait: Adding voice, captions and animations — about 1–3 minutes per video.
job.leave: You can leave this screen — we'll keep working.
job.planFailed: Check your internet and the “who writes scripts” choice in ⚙️ Settings, then try again.
job.renderFailed: Check that your clips play normally, then try again. If it still fails, try a quick preview first.
celebrate.videosText: Watch them, download them, or let us schedule them on TikTok.
celebrate.schedText: We'll send each video to TikTok at its time. You can edit any time or caption below.
celebrate.schedTextNoConn: Don't forget to connect your TikTok account above, otherwise we can't post for you.
scripts.title: Your {n} video scripts
scripts.sub: Ranked from most likely to go viral. Each has what to say, what to film, and a caption.
scripts.waitText: Takes 2–6 minutes. Feel free to do something else — they'll appear here.
scripts.noneText: The last try didn't finish. Tap below to try again.
scripts.research: What we found about your product
scripts.flagWords: Careful with these words (TikTok may block them):
scripts.edit: Change words, captions or timing ({n} parts)
scripts.editHint: Change anything, then save. Videos you make after this will use your changes.
research.trends: What's working in this niche now
adv.planJson: Advanced: edit the whole plan as code (JSON)
adv.planJsonHint: For people comfortable with code. If the format is wrong, nothing is saved and we'll tell you.
manual.title: Free mode: 3 easy steps
manual.sub: Let free ChatGPT or Claude write the scripts. You just copy, paste, and copy the answer back.
manual.copied: Copied! Now paste it into ChatGPT or Claude.
manual.s2: Open ChatGPT or Claude, paste, and send
manual.s2hint: Turn on web search for better results.
manual.s3: Copy the whole answer and paste it here
manual.pastePh: Paste the whole answer from ChatGPT / Claude here
manual.empty: Nothing pasted yet — copy the answer from ChatGPT/Claude into the box first.
film.packText: Every shot to film and every line to record, in one page. Print it or open it on your phone while filming.
film.t2: Film in the order of the list (V1-S01, V1-S02 …)
film.t3: No need to rename files — we match them by when they were filmed
film.t4: Film 2–3 extra seconds before and after each shot
film.t5: Retakes are fine — we use the last take
film.t6: iPhone: turn off HDR (Settings → Camera → Record Video) so colours don't look washed out
film.v1: Find the lines under 🎙 Voice recording in the filming guide
film.v2: Read all lines in one take, with a short pause between lines
film.v3: Record video or audio — we only use the sound
film.v4: Record in a quiet room, phone about a hand-span from your mouth
film.voiceTip: We split your voice into sentences and line them up with the pictures and captions for you.
need.planText: This step opens once your scripts are ready.
upload.clipsText: Send them all — no renaming needed, we match them to shots for you. Background music is welcome too.
upload.bigFiles: Huge files? Copy them into the folder in Finder, then tap Refresh.
upload.voiceText: Video or audio of you reading the script (one file per video). We only use the sound.
upload.whichVoice: Which recording goes with which video
upload.matchSome: {have} of {total} shots have a clip. You can still make videos — Claude fills the gaps with your other clips.
upload.matchHint: We match automatically. If something's wrong, just pick another file.
upload.music: Background music (optional — it gets quieter while you talk)
upload.nextHint: Send at least one clip first.
upload.keepOpen: Keep this screen open until it's done.
make.chooseText: Pick an animation style you like. Tap 🎲 for a fresh variation of the same style.
make.versionsHint: Each extra version uses the next style.
make.none: No finished videos yet. Tap “Make my videos” above.
make.shuffled: New variation ready — make the video to see it
set.title: Settings
set.whoWritesHint: Only used for writing scripts. Video editing never uses AI and is always free.
set.keyClaudeCodeHint: On your Mac, open Terminal, type claude setup-token, and paste the code here.
set.keyClaudeHint: Create one at console.anthropic.com → API Keys.
set.keyOpenaiHint: Create one at platform.openai.com → API keys.
set.needKey: Paste your code first, or choose the free option.
set.voiceMineDesc: Record yourself reading each script — sounds most natural.
set.voiceTtsDesc: Uses the Mac's Kanya voice — no recording needed.
set.advancedHint: Most people never need to change these.
set.qualityHint: Lower = sharper but bigger files (20 recommended)
set.datasetHint: Export your inspiration sheet as CSV (columns like Transcription, Plays…). The top 25 Thai videos become examples for every script.
set.ccMissing: Claude Code not found (only needed for “Your Claude account”)
set.keysLocal: All keys stay on this computer only (~/ThaiTikTokStudio/settings.json).
ob.welcomeText: It makes TikTok selling videos easy. You get 3 helpers:
ob.tool1: Script writer — enter a product, get 5 scripts and a list of shots to film
ob.tool2: Video editor — send your clips and voice, get ready-to-post videos with captions and animations
ob.tool3: Poster — plans posts at the best times, writes captions and posts to TikTok
ob.aiTitle: Who should write your scripts? (one-time setup)
ob.aiText: Pick what suits you. You can change it any time.
ob.keyPh: Paste your code here (stays on this computer)
ob.aiTip: Change it any time with the ⚙️ button at the top right.
ob.needKey: Paste your code first, or choose the free option.
ob.s1b: Type the product name, paste a TikTok Shop / Shopee / Lazada link, or add a screenshot
ob.s1c: Tap Write my scripts and wait 2–6 minutes
ob.s1get: You get 5 scripts, ranked by viral chance, with shot lists and a printable filming guide.
ob.s1tip: Scripts never say the real selling price, and no prices appear on screen (TikTok rules).
ob.edit1: Open your product and go to 📤 Upload
ob.edit2: Tap 📱 Send files from my phone and scan the QR (same Wi‑Fi), or choose files on this device
ob.edit3: Check the matching (change it if needed)
ob.edit4: Pick a style and tap 🎬 Make my videos
ob.editTip: Want to test? Make 2–5 versions and see which one people like more.
ob.sched2: First time: connect TikTok through PostPeer and video storage Cloudinary (both free)
ob.sched3: Choose posts per day and tap ✨ Plan my posts — we pick the best times and write captions (no prices)
ob.sched4: At post time the video lands in your TikTok drafts → open the app → add the product basket → post
ob.schedTip: Edit any time, caption or hashtags. Tap 🔄 for a fresh caption.
ob.ready1: Every screen shows a 💡 Next step with a button to tap.
ob.ready2: Open this guide again with the ❓ button · change language with 🌐.
phone.title: Send files from your phone
phone.qrAlt: QR code that opens the upload page on your phone
phone.s1: Make sure your phone and this computer are on the same Wi‑Fi
phone.s1web: Open your phone camera (any internet works)
phone.s2: Open the phone camera and scan this QR
phone.s3: Tap Choose clips or Choose voice and pick files from your gallery
phone.waiting: Waiting for files from your phone…
phone.tip: Files arrive in full quality (not compressed like LINE) · the link works for {h} hours, for this product only
sched.title: Post to TikTok
sched.sub: We pick the times Thai viewers are most active, write the captions, and post for you.
sched.setupSub: 3 easy steps, about 5 minutes, all free.
sched.s1Text: We use a free service called PostPeer to post for you (20 free posts/month). Sign up at postpeer.dev
sched.ppKeyHint: In PostPeer, open Access Keys → copy the key and paste it here.
sched.noAccts: No TikTok account found yet — tap “Connect TikTok” and log in first.
sched.loginHint: Log in to TikTok in the page that opened, then come back and tap “Done — load my accounts”.
sched.s2Text: Free — lets posts go out even when the app is closed. Sign up at cloudinary.com → Dashboard → copy the API environment variable (cloudinary://…) · videos are removed from Cloudinary 7 days after posting.
sched.modeInboxTitle: Send to TikTok drafts (best for affiliates)
sched.modeInboxDesc: At post time the video arrives in your TikTok inbox → open the app → add the product basket → post (10 seconds)
sched.modeDirectDesc: Posts by itself on time, but can't add the product basket (TikTok doesn't allow it) — add it later in Seller Center
sched.host.website: videos are sent straight from your website
sched.host.cloudinary: videos stored on Cloudinary — the app doesn't need to be open
sched.host.litterbox: Cloudinary not set up — open the app at least once a day
sched.autoText: We post the highest-scoring videos first, mix products, and keep similar versions at least 2 days apart.
sched.noneReady: No new videos yet — make some videos first, then come back.
sched.times: Best Thai times: Mon–Thu 8 pm · Fri 8:30 pm · Sat 7 pm · Sun 8 pm · lunch 12:15
sched.emptyText: Finish some videos, then tap “✨ Plan my posts” above.
sched.caption: Caption (no price · invites people to tap the basket)
err.generic: Something went wrong. Try again — if it keeps happening, close and reopen the app.
err.offline: Can't connect. Check your internet or Wi‑Fi and try again.
err.needProduct: Type a product name, paste a link, or add a screenshot.
err.renderRunning: Videos for this product are already being made. Please wait for them to finish.
err.folder: Folders only open when the app runs on your own computer.
err.notFound: We couldn't find that — it may have been deleted.
err.csv: We couldn't read that CSV. It needs Thai transcripts and play counts.
err.paste: The pasted answer is incomplete or in the wrong format. Copy the whole answer from ChatGPT/Claude again (if it got cut off, type “continue” and copy both parts).
err.upload: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
err.postpeer: Couldn't connect to PostPeer/TikTok. Check your PostPeer key and try again.
err.cloudinary: Cloudinary didn't work. Check you copied the whole cloudinary://… address, then try again.
err.postFailed: That didn't work for this post. Check the TikTok connection above and try again.
